unlisted_practices: Emotion induction with evocative videos before interaction to improve depression detection
Data augmentation with public social media corpora and LLM-generated synthetic samples
Lightweight multimodal fusion for real-time deployment on social robots

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a multimodal social robot framework (DEPRESAR-Fusion) using LLMs and audiovisual cues for depression detection with human interaction and benchmark datasets, but it evaluates the novel system/architecture rather than a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
